notes: Today's sponsor insight is from MFS, the $528 billion asset managers founded in 1924 and credited with creating the first ever mutual fund. Carol Geremia is the President and Head of Global Distribution, where she oversees the firm's worldwide client facing efforts and helps drive MFS' long-term corporate strategy. In her 37 years at MFS, Carol has served as the Co-Head of Global Distribution, President of the firm's Institutional Business, and President of MFS Retirement Services. Our conversation covers Carol's early years at MFS, path to her current role, the firm's 100-year history, and its culture. We dive into the firm's research process, team structure, and strategic evolution, and then then turn to what Carol is hearing from investors, opportunities and risks, ESG, and driving change in the industry.  Today's sponsor insight is from MFS, the $528 billion asset
managers founded in 1924 and credited with creating the first ever
mutual fund.

Carol Geremia is the President and Head of Global Distribution,
where she oversees the firm's worldwide client facing efforts and
helps drive MFS' long-term corporate strategy. In her 37 years at
MFS, Carol has served as the Co-Head of Global Distribution,
President of the firm's Institutional Business, and President of
MFS Retirement Services.

Our conversation covers Carol's early years at MFS, path to her
current role, the firm's 100-year history, and its culture. We dive
into the firm's research process, team structure, and strategic
evolution, and then then turn to what Carol is hearing from
investors, opportunities and risks, ESG, and driving change in the
industry.

 About the Podcast 
 
 
 Allocator and asset management expert, Ted Seides, conducts in-depth interviews with leaders in the institutional investing industry. Guests include Chief Investment Officers from leading allocators, asset managers, strategists, thought leaders, and many more. Our mission is to learn, share, and help implement the process of premier investors. Learn more and join our community at capitalallocators.com.
